name: NSW Rent and Sales Report
publisher: NSW Department of Communities and Justice

measures.definition: Median weekly rent of one-bedroom homes (every dwelling type) in new bonds lodged in Greater Sydney in the quarter, times 52 over 12.
Median weekly rent of three-bedroom homes (every dwelling type) in new bonds lodged in Greater Sydney in the quarter, times 52 over 12.

vetted.notes: Official bond lodgements (new tenancies); the department's copyright page puts its material under CC BY 4.0. Victoria's equivalent (DataVic, CC BY 4.0) is open too, but its files refuse non-browser downloads, so Melbourne has no figure yet.

caveats: Greater Sydney as a whole; the inner city costs more.
